newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: WOLTERS KLUWER TO BUY NEW ZEALAND ADIS.
newsitem.headline: WOLTERS KLUWER TO BUY NEW ZEALAND ADIS.

text.p: Dutch publisher Wolters Kluwer NV said on Monday it was had reached broad agreement on the takeover of all shares in Adis International group, a New Zealand based pharmaceuticals publisher.
Adis is world leader in its specialist area of drug and disease management publishing, with annual sales of approximately 85 million guilders.
Adis employs 370 full-time staff and it has operations in 10 countries from which its products are sold worldwide.

"The intended acquisition of Adis is in line with the strategy of Wolters Kluwer to strengthen its position in medical publishing worldwide, as well as its policy to expand in the Pacific area," it said.
Wolters Kluwer expects a sales level over 1996 of approximately 4.2 billion guilders.
